case.pattern_description: Card-present activity on this card that matches none of the five documented typologies: the billing region is one the cardholder already uses, there is no testing sequence and no device link, yet the transaction sits outside the card's own amount and product profile. It affects this cardholder only, and was found by comparing the flagged transaction against the card's full history rather than by matching a known pattern.

0. What the agent starts with Every transaction carries a `risk_score` between 0 and 1 from the bank's detection model. The model is useful and imperfect: many high scores are legitimate, and some fraud scores low. A score is a reason to look, never a verdict. The only confirmed outcomes are in the closed cases.
